description: This file defines the `AccessControl` struct within the `WPEFramework::Core` namespace. It provides static methods for managing file ownership and permissions on POSIX systems, including functions to change ownership (`OwnerShip`), modify permissions (`Permission`), and apply access control settings based on `NodeId` objects (`Apply`).

classes.name: AccessControl
classes.description: A struct providing static methods to manage file ownership and permissions.

methods.name: uint32_t OwnerShip(const string & node,const string & userName,const string & groupName)
methods.description: Sets the owner and group of a specified file node based on provided username and groupname.

methods.name: uint32_t Permission(const string & node,const uint16_t modeFlags)
methods.description: Sets the permissions of a specified file node based on mode flags.

methods.name: uint32_t Apply(const Core::NodeId & node)
methods.description: Applies ownership and permission settings to a node based on its attributes.
